meaning:
1) to act emptily, become vain, be vain
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to become vain
1a2) to be utterly vain (with cognate acc)
1b) (Hiphil)
1b1) to cause to become vain
1b2) to fill with vain hopes

renderings.bsb: They are filling you with false hopes

elsewhere.note: They rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified to them; and they followed vanity, and…
Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?
Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
Yahweh says, “What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me, that they have gone far from me, and have walked after worthless vanity, and have become…
